name: webtransport-jam-probe
description: THROWAWAY probe: measure round-trip latency of a WebTransport+WebCodecs audio path vs the current WebRTC/mediasoup network-monitor. Not part of the pnpm workspace; not wired into the app or systemd.
comment: Pinned to 1.4.x: the 1.5.1+ prebuilt arm64 quiche binary needs GLIBC_2.38, but the Pi (Debian 12 Bookworm) has 2.36. Transport 1.4.0 is the newest prebuild that loads under 2.36. overrides forces the transport to match so it isn't bumped to a glibc-2.38 build.
